desc:
When you migrate to PrestaShop or upgrade an old PrestaShop version, your catalog, customers and links move to a platform you can rely on. Ecom Swift LLC maps your data, tests the import, then runs the full move with redirects from your old addresses.

## What is a PrestaShop migration?

A PrestaShop migration is the controlled transfer of a shop's data into PrestaShop, either from another platform or from an older PrestaShop release. The data includes products, combinations, categories, manufacturers, images, customers, addresses, CMS pages and, in larger projects, order history.

An upgrade follows the same logic inside one platform. The old shop is carried forward to the current release, with its data and modules checked along the way.

## Why moves go wrong without a plan

Platforms store data differently. A product with sizes and colors on one system may be many separate products on another. Category trees, tax settings and customer records rarely line up by themselves. A rushed move leaves missing images, broken combinations, duplicate categories and customers who cannot sign in.

The larger risk sits outside the data. Every old page address that no longer works is a dead end for visitors and for search engines. An old shop that stays on PrestaShop 1.6 faces a different problem: its themes and modules may not run on a newer release, so the upgrade needs its own plan.

## How a careful move protects your results

A careful move protects the traffic, orders and customer relationships you have already built. When products arrive complete, shoppers find what they expect. When old links redirect to the matching new pages, bookmarks, backlinks and search results keep working. When customer accounts and addresses carry over, returning buyers do not start from zero.

We cannot promise that search rankings will stay the same. They depend on many things, including how much the new site differs from the old one. What we can do is reduce the avoidable losses: missing pages, broken links and incomplete data.

## What a good migration includes

- A mapping sheet that pairs every old field with its place in PrestaShop.
- Products with images, descriptions and combinations carried over correctly.
- Categories and manufacturers rebuilt in a clean structure.
- Customer accounts and addresses moved, with a plan for passwords.
- Order history moved where the package includes it.
- CMS pages such as About, Terms and Delivery copied across.
- Redirects from old addresses to the matching new ones.
- A test import and a sample for you to approve before the full run.
- A data check that compares counts and samples against the old shop.
- Help on launch day, when the domain switches to the new shop.

## How we run the move

We begin by listing what exists on the old shop and what you want to keep. We map the fields, then run a test import into a copy of the new PrestaShop. You review a sample of products, categories and customers, and we correct anything that looks off.

After your approval we run the full import and compare totals against the old shop. We then build the redirect list and test it. The Basic package covers products and categories. Standard adds customers, redirects and CMS pages with a side by side data check. Premium adds order history, a larger redirect set, or the upgrade of an older PrestaShop 1.6 or 1.7 shop, plus help on launch day.

## What to do and what to avoid

**Do:**
- Export a full backup of your old shop before we start.
- Clean obvious junk, such as dead products, before the move.
- Review the sample import carefully and reply with questions.
- Keep the old shop running until the new one is confirmed.
- Tell us about every module whose job you need to keep.

**Avoid:**
- Switching your domain before the data check is complete.
- Changing products on the old shop during the final import window.
- Moving every old module without asking if it is still needed.
- Skipping redirects because the new addresses look tidy.
- Cancelling the old hosting too early.

## Who this is for

This service suits sellers outgrowing another platform who want PrestaShop's control and its large module ecosystem. It suits owners of an older PrestaShop shop that no longer receives updates. It also suits agencies passing a client store to a new owner who need the data moved cleanly.

## How to get started

Tell us where your shop lives now, roughly how many products and customers it has and what you want to keep. Give us admin or collaborator access to the old shop, or send an export file. We never need your passwords. We reply with a checklist and begin the mapping.
